title: Naturally Smoky Ukrainian Shallots Skewers
description: A spicy and crisp Ukrainian dish featuring shallots, this crowd-pleaser is perfect for any occasion, served in a Korean brass bowl. It is egg-free friendly and smoked to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, making sure it reaches a safe temperature of 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and chili flakes.
Add the chopped shallots to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the coated shallots onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shallot.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the shallots are tender and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and brush with lemon juice.
Serve the skewers hot in a Korean brass bowl, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving to ensure food safety.
